title: Broken Object Level Authorization (IDOR) on Telemetry Document Export Endpoint
description: The document export endpoint fails to validate whether the requested document identifier belongs to the currently authenticated user session, allowing unauthorized cross-account document retrieval.
impact: Authenticated users with standard privileges can read and download restricted telemetry archive documents belonging to other accounts by iterating the sequential 'id' parameter.
steps_to_reproduce: Authenticate to https://portal.nusatech.local using Test Account A (user_id: 501) and record the document export URL for an owned report (e.g., id=801).
Open an isolated incognito browser session and authenticate using Test Account B (user_id: 502).
Send a GET request to https://portal.nusatech.local/api/v1/documents/export?id=801 using Test Account B's session and observe that Test Account A's document is returned with HTTP 200 OK.
raw_http_request:
GET /api/v1/documents/export?id=801&api_key=sk_live_dummy9988 HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.nusatech.local
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.dummysecret
Cookie: session_id=sess_dummy12345; theme=dark
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0

title: SQL Injection on Observation Station Filter Parameter
description: The 'station' query parameter is concatenated directly into a backend SQL statement without parameterized query binding or strict input type validation.
impact: An unauthenticated remote attacker can manipulate the SQL query structure to extract database schemas, read sensitive tables, and potentially modify observation records.
steps_to_reproduce: Send a baseline GET request to https://portal.nusatech.local/api/v1/observations/filter?station=101 and record the standard JSON response.
Supply a boolean-based SQL test payload in the station parameter to verify query evaluation differences.
Observe the deterministic difference in the returned dataset confirming direct SQL interpretation.
raw_http_request:
GET /api/v1/observations/filter?station=101 HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.nusatech.local
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0
Accept: application/json

title: Verbose Server Banner Information Disclosure on Legacy Archive Subdomain
description: The legacy archive server exposes detailed web server and module version banners in HTTP response headers (Note: Target is Out-of-Scope).
impact: Facilitates version fingerprinting of internal server components on a legacy host.
steps_to_reproduce: Send an HTTP HEAD request to https://legacy-archive.nusatech.local/status.
Inspect the Server and X-Powered-By headers in the response.
